activation.activation_reason: Run 47 was verified NO_CHANGE with zero candidates and is the final pre-contract run. Candidate state begins prospectively after it; historical monitor experiments are not retroactively promoted into the queue.

identity.canonical_field_mode: Hash sorted occurrence scope plus only the canonical fields actually proposed to change and their proposed values.
identity.opaque_rule_mode: For legal/rule/topology candidates, hash sorted occurrence scope, candidate type and normalized proposed new rule state.
identity.merge_rule: Repeated observations with the same review_item_id aggregate into one review item and never create duplicate pending work.
identity.sibling_rule: A materially different proposition receives a different review_item_id and does not automatically supersede an earlier item.

retention_limit.implication: This v0.1 reducer is complete only inside the retained Actions evidence horizon. It is not yet a permanent pending-candidate database.
retention_limit.safety_rule: Do not grant monitor or Pages workflows repository contents-write authority merely to persist the queue.
retention_limit.next_gate: Design an independently constrained durable checkpoint mechanism before claiming indefinite pending-review persistence.
